facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa reports that the Health and Social Action Minister approved a national digital health policy framework on 28 April 2025, with a digital health law still in draft, and that the PAEN project plans to extend the electronic patient record to six additional regions starting in 2025.

We Are Tech Africa reports that the electronic patient record is promoted under the Digital Economy Acceleration Project (PAEN), a USD 150 million initiative financed by the World Bank through 2028; no domestic budget line is stated.

We Are Tech Africa reports that the electronic patient record had completed a pilot phase in four Dakar facilities: the Abass Ndao and Thierno Birahim Ndao hospitals (tier not stated), the Khadim Rassoul health centre and the HLM Fass health post; the pilot is undated, so the article's publication date is used.

We Are Tech Africa names one health centre (Khadim Rassoul) and one health post (HLM Fass), both in Dakar, as the primary-level sites of the electronic patient record pilot, beside two hospitals; no denominator is given and the pilot is undated, so the article's publication date is used.

systems.owner: under the World Bank-financed PAEN; digital health policy approved by the Ministry of Health and Social Action
systems.tiers: pilot in Dakar: Abass Ndao and Thierno Birahim Ndao hospitals, Khadim Rassoul health centre, HLM Fass health post; six more regions planned from 2025
